request: 保守地远离 Boss，挖矿和清野发育，真实长局到掉帧后分析日志。
method: One real-clock normal-rules battle, continued across recorder segments. Periodic automatic diagnostic stops, upgrades and menus exclude paused time. Controller is automated; this is not a human manual playthrough or an optimization A/B.
recording_notes: One run, 51 recorder sessions; upgrade and automatic diagnostic pauses excluded from active intervals.
Controller uses held movement and normal reward/build callbacks, not human manual UI play.
Pilot became conservative in a small safe region after development; body overlap is a possible rendering factor. NPC/part counts continue growing.
Enemy AI timings are nested short-window samples, biased toward slow windows; do not add them to parent combat times.
TIME_PROCESS monitor values and GPU time are not interchangeable; release static RAM monitor was unavailable.

targeted_change.scope: Only large actor movement sweeps, radius 64–512 and displacement <=16 px. Identical start/end/radius, unchanged terrain revision and solver flags.
targeted_change.invalidation: World reset, terrain revision, solver mode.
targeted_change.caller_ownership: Return fresh dictionaries; retain an independent shallow copy of value-only contact records.
targeted_change.unchanged: Original collision solver and tie winner, visual art/effects, damage, rates, enemy counts and simulation cadence. Ordinary projectile wall_hit stays on the original path.

checks.name: Cached empty contacts are fresh dictionaries owned by each caller
The query fixture contains a real circular rock contact
Changing a returned contact cannot corrupt a later cache hit
Nearby coordinates, distinct radii, reverse movement and uncached long sweeps retain exact contacts
A constant-time ring bounds retained queries at 1024 entries
Terrain revisions discard stale answers before serving a query
New worlds clear query history even when the revision resets to zero
Diagnostic solver mode changes cannot reuse another mode's results

micro_reproducer.scope: ABBA headless navigation/collision micro-reproducer from recorded root actors. Same procedural seed, mining edits not restored, no rendered FPS claim.

micro_kernel_profile.scope: ABBA headless navigation/collision micro-reproducer from recorded root actors. Same procedural seed, mining edits not restored, no rendered FPS claim.

rejected_expanded_neighborhood.scope: ABBA headless navigation/collision micro-reproducer from recorded root actors. Same procedural seed, mining edits not restored, no rendered FPS claim.

micro_limitations: Not rendered gameplay FPS. Root positions/radii and procedural seed were reused, but excavation edits and the complete battle state were not restored.
ABBA samples varied substantially with host timing; the production-cache run included a maximum sample of 129.124ms, higher than its 121.863ms legacy maximum. Do not claim all slow frames improved.
The earlier expanded-neighborhood prototype was not enabled in normal gameplay.

release_smoke.scope: 15-second isolated native rendering/real-time fixture to validate executable and journaling, not a long-run A/B.

checks.name: Measured production frames include actual excavation and mineral drops
Every timed frame advances real combat; paused, reward and result screens never count as gameplay FPS
All configured modules remain alive and available throughout the measured battle

remaining: The new cache has not completed a second real 30-minute gameplay run. Stable 60 FPS is not demonstrated.

micro_profile_correction.issue: Old V1 CPU micro-profile applied survival heat_speed to Endless bosses. Those CPU timings do not describe the real Endless battle; actual gameplay clocks and FPS measurements are unaffected.
